title: An algebraic-space-representable presheaf over an algebraic space is an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and work on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site]. Let $P:(\mathit{Sch}/S)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathit{Sets}$ be a presheaf of sets, let $Z$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $a:P\to Z$ be a natural transformation. For an $S$-scheme $T$, write $h_T(U)=\operatorname{Mor}_S(U,T)$. Assume that for every $S$-scheme $T$ and every natural transformation $t:h_T\to Z$, the presheaf fibre product $h_T\times_Z P$ is isomorphic to the presheaf of an algebraic space over $S$. Here the presheaf fibre product has value $\{(u,p)\in h_T(U)\times P(U):t_U(u)=a_U(p)\}$ at $U$, with componentwise restrictions. Then $P$ is an algebraic space over $S$; in particular no sheaf condition on $P$ is assumed in the hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 02YS, lemma-representable-by-spaces-over-space (statement); its hypothesis of representability by algebraic spaces is expanded into scheme tests.

proof.text: Prove fppf descent by the Yoneda sheaf condition. For a covering sieve C on T and f:C→P, extend f a uniquely in the sheaf Z to t:h_T→Z. The equality C→h_T→Z = C→P→Z gives l:C→h_T×_Z P. The hypothesis identifies this pullback with an algebraic-space sheaf, so l extends uniquely to v:h_T→h_T×_Z P. Then v followed by the P projection extends f. For another extension g:h_T→P, uniqueness in Z gives g a=t, and hence (1,g) is a map to the pullback extending l; uniqueness there gives g=v pr_P. This also treats empty covering sieves. This is the fully proved private isSheaf_of_fibres helper.

Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas u:h_U→Z from the algebraic-space definition. By hypothesis there are an algebraic space B and an isomorphism e:h_U×_Z P≅B. Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas b:h_W→B. Define p=b e⁻¹ pr_P:h_W→P.

The helper representableWith_iff identifies IsRepresentableWith Q with Mathlib Q.relative yoneda, by uniqueness of representing pullback schemes. Relative morphism properties are stable under arbitrary presheaf base change, contain isomorphisms when Q does, and are closed under composition when Q is. Apply these results to Q=etale and Q=surjective on Over S. The second pullback projection is the base change of u and hence has each property; compose with e⁻¹ and b. Thus p is representable etale and representable surjective. This is precisely the two pasted scheme-test squares and composition of surjective etale projections in the source; it does not assume P algebraic and does not compose maps merely representable by algebraic spaces.

Apply the scheme-test definition of etaleness of p to p itself to obtain R with IsPullback(h_s,h_t,p,p). Use lem-a1-representable-etale-kernel-relation for the sheaf P established in step 1 to obtain the sectionwise equivalence relation and etaleness of s,t. The pair (s,t):R→W×_S W is monic in Over S: maps with equal pairs give equal maps to h_R by the representing square, and are equal by faithfulness of Yoneda.

proof.text: Apply lem-a1-representable-etale-fppf-local-lifting to p and the fppf sheaf P. Its locally-surjective conclusion says every section of P lifts on an fppf covering; no global lift is claimed.

source.place: Tag 02YS, last paragraph, W→F is a surjection of sheaves

proof.text: Let Q₀ be the presheaf coequalizer of h_s,h_t and η:Q₀→P its induced map, so πη=p. The helper quotient_unit_mono proves η monic: choose sectionwise representatives w₁,w₂ of two quotient sections; equality of their P images gives r∈R(T) with projections w₁,w₂ by the pullback square; the coequalizer condition then identifies their classes. Since πη=p is locally surjective, η is locally surjective. Put K=range(η), so Q₀≅K because η is monic. Its subsheaf closure K# inside P is all P by local surjectivity, and K#→P is therefore an isomorphism. For every fppf sheaf H, maps K→H extend uniquely over K# by Mathlib Subfunctor.sheafifyLift and Subfunctor.to_sheafify_lift_unique. Compose with Q₀≅K and K#≅P to obtain the required bijection Hom(P,H)→Hom(Q₀,H) by precomposition with η. This is the fully proved reflection_of_locally_bijective helper and proves the specified sheafification universal property without assuming HasSheafify for Type u on the big site.

source.place: Tag 02YS, last paragraph, identification F=W/R; universal-property argument via subsheaf closure

proof.text: The schemes R,W and s,t meet the etale-equivalence-relation hypotheses by step 4. Step 6 supplies exactly the presheaf coequalizer unit η and the sheafification universal property required by lem-trf-etale-relation-quotient. Apply that theorem to the sheaf P from step 1, with this η, to obtain IsAlgebraicSpace P.
